result.summary: The page is largely intact and the horizontal carousels and bottom-cut card are expected behavior, but the promotional banner contains implausible/placeholder copy and the delivery-time formats are inconsistent.

issues.description: The promo banner text reads "3 free deliveries for you" with the code TALLINN3, but a food delivery promotion promising three free deliveries is implausible and appears to be placeholder or incorrect copy.
issues.suggestion: Replace with accurate promotional wording, e.g. a discount or free delivery over a minimum order, and verify the promo code and conditions.

issues.description: In the "Fastest near you" row, Green Bowl Poké is labeled "15-25 min" while the two neighboring restaurants are labeled "20-30 min", producing a mismatched time format that looks inconsistent.
issues.suggestion: Use a consistent time-range format across all restaurant cards, such as "20-30 min".
